units.source: Internal (reference) links
Internal links are links to other notes within Trilium.
You can open an internal link by clicking it. You can also see a read-only preview of an internal link's contents by hovering over it.
Since v0.107.0, clicking an internal link while editing a text note shows its popup instead, as clicking an external link does:

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Open note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ opens the linked note, or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Open attachment__TRILIUM_PH_3__ for a link to an attachment. A link into the same note reads __TRILIUM_PH_4__Jump to heading__TRILIUM_PH_5__, __TRILIUM_PH_6__Jump to block__TRILIUM_PH_7__ or __TRILIUM_PH_8__Jump to anchor__TRILIUM_PH_9__ instead, and scrolls to it without leaving the note.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Download__TRILIUM_PH_2__, for a link to an attachment, downloads the attachment.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ changes the link, as described below.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu, with __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Open note__TRILIUM_PH_5__ first, which does what the first button does, then __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__Open note in a new tab__TRILIUM_PH_8__, __TRILIUM_PH_9__ __TRILIUM_PH_10__Open note in a new split__TRILIUM_PH_11__, __TRILIUM_PH_12__ __TRILIUM_PH_13__Open note in a new window__TRILIUM_PH_14__ and __TRILIUM_PH_15__ __TRILIUM_PH_16__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_17__, then __TRILIUM_PH_18__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_19__ and __TRILIUM_PH_20__ __TRILIUM_PH_21__Unlink__TRILIUM_PH_22__, which turns the link into plain text. A link that shows the title of the note ends with __TRILIUM_PH_23__Convert link to an included note__TRILIUM_PH_24__, described in __TRILIUM_PH_25__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_26__. A link to an attachment lists the actions on the attachment between __TRILIUM_PH_27__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_28__ and __TRILIUM_PH_29__Unlink__TRILIUM_PH_30__, except __TRILIUM_PH_31__ __TRILIUM_PH_32__Delete attachment...__TRILIUM_PH_33__, which follows __TRILIUM_PH_34__Unlink__TRILIUM_PH_35__, and ends with converting the attachment into a note. A link to blocks of the same note leaves out the ways to open the note elsewhere.
In a note being edited, right-clicking a link also opens this menu.

To follow the link without the popup, __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+click or double-click it, which does what the first button of the popup does, or place the cursor in it and press __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_5__. On a touch device, touch and hold the link, then choose the first entry of its menu, such as __TRILIUM_PH_6__Open note__TRILIUM_PH_7__ or __TRILIUM_PH_8__Jump to heading__TRILIUM_PH_9__. To open the note in a new tab, click it with the middle mouse button. The preview does not show while the popup is open.
A link in an __TRILIUM_PH_0__included note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ that is not __TRILIUM_PH_2__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_3__ opens on a click, as in a read-only note.
Inserting internal links__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Internal links can be created at the current position in a text note by:

Pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__L__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ button underneath the __TRILIUM_PH_5__ menu in the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_7__, or by choosing __TRILIUM_PH_8__Link to a note (internal link)__TRILIUM_PH_9__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_10__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_11__. On desktop, the __TRILIUM_PH_12__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_13__ dialog opens in a popup next to the cursor.

Searching for the title of the desired note to link. It's also possible to create new notes from this dialog by typing a non-existing note title and selecting either __TRILIUM_PH_0__Create note__TRILIUM_PH_1__, which places it in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note Inbox__TRILIUM_PH_3__ (today's day note, or the top level, when no inbox is set), or __TRILIUM_PH_4__Create child note__TRILIUM_PH_5__, which places it under the note being edited.
There are two link types, depending on the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_1__ field of the dialog:
When the link title is not set, the link will display the title of the note. If the title of the note gets changed, the link will be renamed automatically to the new name.
This is sometimes also called "reference link".
The icon of the linked note will also be displayed.

If the linked note is deleted, the link keeps the last title it showed, in red and with a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ icon instead of the note icon. Clicking it while editing opens the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Fix link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ dialog, which searches for that title; picking a note, or creating a new one, replaces the link with one to that note.
When a link title is typed, the link shows that text instead.
This will create a traditional hyperlink, where the text of the link can be different from the note title.

Since v0.107.0, to change a link, click it and press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button in its popup. For a link with a title of its own, placing the cursor inside it and pressing __TRILIUM_PH_3__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_4__ + __TRILIUM_PH_5__L__TRILIUM_PH_6__ or the __TRILIUM_PH_7__ button works too. The __TRILIUM_PH_8__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_9__ dialog opens on the linked note, with its anchor and, for a link with a title of its own, the link's text; __TRILIUM_PH_10__Save link__TRILIUM_PH_11__ changes the whole link. Emptying the __TRILIUM_PH_12__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_13__ there turns the link into one that displays the title of the note, and typing one gives it a title of its own. For a link to an attachment, the dialog shows only the __TRILIUM_PH_14__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_15__, and emptying it makes the link display the title of the attachment.
In-place linking__TRILIUM_PH_0__
You can also insert internal links “inline” by using the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ symbol:
Type __TRILIUM_PH_0__ in a text note, which will open the note search menu.

Search for the desired note's title by typing a few characters. Use __TRILIUM_PH_0__Up__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Down__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to select the correct note, and press __TRILIUM_PH_4__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_5__ or __TRILIUM_PH_6__Tab__TRILIUM_PH_7__ to create the link. It's also possible to create new notes with this method by typing a non-existing note title and selecting __TRILIUM_PH_8__Create note__TRILIUM_PH_9__, as described above, or __TRILIUM_PH_10__Create child note__TRILIUM_PH_11__. __TRILIUM_PH_12__Create child note__TRILIUM_PH_13__ creates the note under the note being edited without asking for its type, inserts the link and opens the new note in __TRILIUM_PH_14__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_15__, which offers the note types to turn it into while it is still empty.
To create an empty child note and link to it before naming it, use __TRILIUM_PH_0__New child note__TRILIUM_PH_1__, described in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert buttons__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
Pasting internal links__TRILIUM_PH_0__
You can also insert internal links by copying a note from the note tree.
In the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__, select a note and press __TRILIUM_PH_2__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_3__ + __TRILIUM_PH_4__C__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
In a text note, paste the link by pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__V__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
